newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's 10-month insurance premiums up 0.4 pct.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's 10-month insurance premiums up 0.4 pct.

text.p: Brazilian insurance premiums in the first ten months of the year rose 0.4 percent to 12.5 billion reais ($12.04 billion) over the same period in 1995, the National Federation of Insurance Firms (Fenaseg) said.
Fenaseg said in a statement that car insurance accounted for 30.5 percent of all premiums and health and life insurance accounted for 19.8 and 18.6 percent, respectively.
Fenaseg said capitalization market revenues between January and October increased 84 percent to 3.401 billion reais ($3.27 billion) over the same period last year.
